context: Karlach and Fytz are old friends who haven’t seen one another in about ten years; this chance reunion happens in Baldur’s Gate. Karlach is travelling incognito and initially disguised, so Fytz’s recognition is a surprise. Fytz repeats a rumor he heard from Gortash that Karlach “ran off to Neverwinter,” which touches a raw nerve because Gortash betrayed her in the past (he was involved in selling her). The player is present and trying to push the conversation onward rather than rehash old betrayals.
